name: outerspace-apizr
description: Read-only Python analysis and exposure planning with explicit project authorization and a separately activated MCP plugin.

project.title: Project file
project.description: Select the absolute path to your apizr.toml, created using the Registry installation guide. This selects the Python source root; no project is chosen automatically.

operator_policy.title: Reviewed analysis policy
operator_policy.description: Select the absolute path to the reviewed operator JSON policy granting source.analyze for this project. Create and review it using the Registry installation guide; installation grants no authority.

plugins_dir.title: Managed plugin directory
plugins_dir.description: Select the absolute directory where you explicitly prepared, installed and activated the matching MCP profile, following the Registry installation guide. Launching does not activate it.
